```plato

    //==
    // # Array — predicates
    //
    // Folds rather than loops with an early exit, which a Plato body cannot
    // write: All and Any visit every element. Boolean && and || short-circuit
    // (docs/SEMANTICS.md section 6), so once the answer is decided the
    // predicate is not called again; a backend that wants the loop itself to
    // stop early supplies it through the override table.

    // True when every element satisfies the predicate (vacuously true when empty).
    All(xs: Array<$T>, f: Function1<$T, Boolean>): Boolean
        => xs.Reduce(true, (acc, x) => acc && f(x));
```
